title: PocketJS Wander
intro: An endless grown world that streams in around the player: towns grow as you reach them, landmarks and rumors wait in the wilds, and the world wanders itself when you put it down. Built on PocketJS and Pocket RPG Kit.

wander.title: Wander: an Endless Grown World
wander.description: An unbounded world streamed in 32x32 chunks around the player: towns grow as you reach them, and chunks load ahead and unload behind within a fixed memory cap. Left alone it wanders by itself; the minimap shows the rings.

controls.action: Walk. Any key takes over from the auto-walk; 10 idle seconds hand it back.
Fast travel on or off (TRI on screen)

wander.pointer: Click or tap a tile to walk there.
